title: Landslide identification using machine learning with generative adversarial networks
summary: A MUSA 650 course project applying machine learning and GAN models to predict landslide occurrence in Hong Kong from spatial conditioning factors, using synthetic data augmentation to address class imbalance in the landslide inventory. It imports SDV's CTGAN synthesizer (via sdv.tabular) and evaluate function to generate synthetic tabular data and boost training set size for the imbalanced landslide dataset.
